findings.highlight: Even if he was involved and prepared as a mage
findings.evidenceJa: どんなに魔術師として覚悟していて、あの神父もこちら側の人間だったとしても
findings.governingReading: However prepared she is as a mage, even with him also belonging to their world, this would not be easy for her.
findings.explanation: Rin’s readiness for loss becomes the priest’s readiness.

findings.governingReading: 猫科 identifies the family of the poised attacking beast.
findings.explanation: A feline predator becomes an unspecified wild animal.

findings.governingReading: The phrase attributes the magecraft to the king of Colchis, whose daughter is then identified as Medea.
findings.explanation: “King Colchis” presents the realm as a personal name. The local lineage and identification of Medea nevertheless remain intact.

findings.highlight: take away half your powers at most.
findings.evidenceJa: せいぜいその半身を断つ程度
findings.governingReading: 半身を断つ describes the limit of physical sword damage.
findings.explanation: Cutting half a body becomes removing half her power.

findings.governingReading: He has experienced a similar sight.

findings.highlight: Even if the hero that saved many people and embodies my ideals is a man like that
findings.evidenceJa: 理想とも言える英雄が、あんな男だという事も
findings.governingReading: The final も adds another object of Shirou's inability to forgive: a hero embodying his ideal turns out to be such a man.
findings.explanation: Shirou treats the hero's conduct as another reason for outrage. English turns that grievance into an unfinished 'even if' concession.

findings.governingReading: 腰が軽い censures his easy willingness to reverse his earlier refusal.
findings.explanation: Ready switching of allegiance becomes acting quickly.

findings.highlight: She will attack you if you don't hurry.
findings.evidenceJa: 早くしなければおまえに襲いかかってしまうぞ
findings.governingReading: Archer urges Caster to break his contract before Rin can use her remaining Command Spell to make him attack Caster.
findings.explanation: Archer's warning that he could be compelled to attack Caster becomes a warning that Rin will attack her. This obscures why breaking Archer's contract is urgent.

findings.highlight: I need to prove to the world that I am great enough to take you in.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方一人を御し得ないようでは私の器も知れる
findings.governingReading: Caster says failure to control even Archer would expose her limited capacity, answering the risk that he might betray her.
findings.explanation: Caster's confidence that she can control a potential traitor becomes a need to prove her greatness to the world, adding an audience and changing her stated motive.

findings.highlight: this isn't the time to be hesitating over something like that.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな事に躊躇しているあいつじゃない
findings.governingReading: She is not someone who would hesitate over that reaction.
findings.explanation: Rin’s refusal to falter becomes a generic lack of time.

findings.highlight: a speed that makes Tohsaka look stagnant.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が止まって見える速度
findings.governingReading: 止まって見える compares relative movement speed.
